VALIDATION_PROTOCOL.md.contents:
# Protocol registered before new candidate scores

The fixed historical control uses original feature builder, sparse OHE, price/10000,
850 trees and seed42; no stopping or altered regularization. Historical package
versions were not supplied. Current versions and resolved booster config are saved.

Baseline audit: historical raw-duplicate SGKF five folds seed42; new raw-duplicate
SGKF five folds seed20261015; ordinary stratified five-fold seed20261015; semantic
record grouping (drop airline/duration from group key) five-fold seed20261015;
flight-identity grouping five-fold seed20261015 is a stress test, not the selection
metric. No date exists; days_left is booking horizon, not chronological time.

Primary candidate comparison: identical raw-duplicate-blocked outer five folds,
seed20261015. Predeclare no more than three structural hypotheses after train-only
EDA, before candidate scoring. Fixed-round ablations retain 850 exactly; early-stop
procedures may use cap1400/patience75 and two inner fold-pure stops with median
rounds and minimum100, then refit full outer training. Outer labels never choose
rounds. New seed20261016 repeats the baseline and the one preselected winner
without further adjustments. This is repeated-CV confirmation, not new independent
observations: the full labeled dataset has informed prior research.

Promotion gate: pooled original-price delta R2 >= .001 on primary comparison;
positive delta on at least4/5 folds; paired raw-record-group bootstrap lower95%
limit >0; positive repeated-CV pooled delta and at least4/5 positive repeat folds.
Intervals are conditional paired OOF uncertainty, not population or retraining
confidence guarantees. Report flight-cluster uncertainty too. If selection among
multiple candidates is close prefer simplest; never claim tiny gains or reused
Phase5 holdout is independent proof. A conservative Bonferroni paired interval
across tested primary hypotheses will also be reported for a winner.

All EDA and feature fitting uses training only. No Kaggle test features are read
until a frozen manifest records all pipelines, rounds, transformations, weights,
postprocessing, seeds and hashes. Final inference reads test once, validates IDs,
shape and finite nonnegative predictions, and generates only a control refit and
any justified winner. The old best submission is copied byte-for-byte. No
leaderboard-derived choices, NNs, target encoding, pseudo-labeling, target weights,
or repeated failed class-split/bundle experiments. No submission upload is part of
this research turn.

CANDIDATE_REGISTRY.md.contents:
# Registered structural hypotheses

Written before candidate predictions/scores. Primary folds: raw duplicate blocked,
seed20261015. Fixed850 retains exact historical parameters and training scale.

H1 native: replace sparse one-hot category indicators with XGBoost native ordered
categorical partitions. Same semantic columns and rare-flight threshold12; native
unseen categories become missing rather than OHE rare pooling. Finite partition
search max_cat_threshold16 and max_cat_to_onehot1. Depth7/48 leaves, child12,
L1.6/L2 15, gamma.08, row.8/col.85 unchanged. Hypothesis: partitioning carrier,
route and class subsets costs fewer splits than separate indicators and avoids
column-budget fragmentation. Risk: sparse categories/partition overfit. It is a
whole representation change, not an isolated one-bit encoding comparison.

H2 duration_schedule: feature-only duration hierarchy, accepted for price-model
comparison only if train-only random masking reconstruction improves; add flight,
route, stops, departure/arrival matching ahead of original fallback, without target
statistics. Keep all model parameters and features otherwise unchanged. Imputation
rule must be fixed from reconstruction diagnostic before price-model scoring.

H3 prefix_duration: append prefix-specific Business-duration gated numeric terms,
using training prefixes only, retaining original features. It differs from failed
Phase4's global class-duration bundle. Observed training Business correlations
vary by prefix (+.71 for6E versus negative forEY), suggesting heterogeneous shapes;
no monotonic constraint is imposed. Bound to at most19 terms, one per observed
training prefix; unknown prefix gets zero terms. Risk: added terms alter column
subsampling and can overfit sparse carriers. No target encoding or price priors.

No combinatorial bundles or extra hyperparameter grid. Use the promotion gate in
VALIDATION_PROTOCOL.md. Rejected candidates remain documented. Advance at most one
unchanged candidate to repeated folds seed20261016. Fixed850 is deliberately held
constant to isolate structure and preserve full-data round policy; no outer fold
is used for early stopping. Separate nested stopping may be reported as an
explicitly new procedure only with a predeclared finite policy.

NESTED_STOPPING_ADDENDUM.md.contents:
# Adaptive addition, declared before its scores

Native850 increased mean train R² to.9810 and decreased outer OOF R² to.92799
versus sparse OHE control.92981. This motivates one finite stopping procedure
within the already registered native representation family, without a depth or
penalty search. This adaptation used previous outer diagnostics and is exploratory;
primary outer folds are not a pristine independent selection test.

Procedure frozen now: each outer training partition creates five raw-duplicate-
blocked decile-stratified inner folds seed=outer_seed+1000+outer_fold; the first two
inner folds each select best_iteration+1 on original-price-equivalent squared
error, cap1400 patience75. Fit the complete feature hierarchy and category levels
on inner fitting rows separately. Median of the two stops, floor100, refits all
outer training and scores outer fold once. Keep all other native parameters
unchanged. One predeclared candidate, no additional variants. Compare to fixed850
control, apply original material-effect/fold/interval gate, include4-procedure
multiplicity sensitivity, and confirm any selected candidate unchanged on seed
20261016. Do not claim repeated folds supply new independent labels.

Full-data rounds, only if this procedure qualifies: evaluate stopping at two
predeclared training fractions .64 and .80 (five fold-pure fits each), report
sample-size/round variability, and use a conservative capped log-linear mapping
to100% only if stable; otherwise retain the predeclared fixed850 winner or baseline.
No final-round selection from Kaggle features or predictions.

BLEND_REGISTRATION.md.contents:
# One fixed blend, registered before computing blend predictions or scores

Exploratory follow-up within structural representation research. Native850 alone
underperformed but baseline/native OOF residual correlation is.93415, and covariance
101676553 is below both residual variances107457581/110248520. Opposite-sign errors
occur18.26%. Thus variance reduction is a plausible reason to consider an ensemble.
This uses exploratory OOF diagnostics; it is not independent confirmation.

Freeze exactly50% original sparse OHE XGB850 +50% native categorical XGB850.
No weight fitting/grid, no inclusion of duration/prefix candidates, no target
transforms/calibration. Both constituent training seeds42; all individual
parameters, feature rules and nonnegative price postprocessing are unchanged.
This is two finite depth7/48leaf850-tree models (1700 total trees); justified
only if it passes the same >=.001 pooled R² / >=4 positive folds / pairedCI gate,
then unchanged repeat seed20261016. Report additional multiplicity sensitivity
for this exploratory family and all stopping additions. No leaderboard fitting.

If it fails any promotion gate it is not a new Kaggle submission. If accepted,
full-data models both keep850 exactly, avoiding a sample-size-dependent round
selection rule. No further blends, weights, or mixtures will be tried in this run.
